category.name: Backup and recovery
category.description: Create recoverable file backups and restore lost data; distinguish managed endpoint services from self-operated backup tools and full-system disaster recovery.
category.audience: Individuals protecting computer files and IT teams operating endpoint or server backups.
category.audienceRationale: File loss and device failure affect personal and business computing; operation of server repositories requires technical administration.

pricing.note: Business Backup shown at $99/year per computer subscription; seat means protected computer. Enterprise Control upgrade quoted separately.

Base amount not rendered in current purchasing page; device/workload-specific licensing. Quote fields represent unverified price, not a claim that every edition is quote-only. Acronis True Image is a separate consumer product.

oss.name: restic
oss.classificationReason: Entire program described as free and completely open source; no paid software feature gates identified. Locally operated CLI, no dedicated server required; selfHostable=false reflects client-tool scope, while storage can be self-hosted.
serviceLimitations: Storage, remote server operation, scheduling and key custody are the operator’s responsibility; cloud storage fees are separate.

health.rsx: Central rsx analyze: overall 7.2/10; advisory health signal, not a security certification.

oss.name: BorgBackup
oss.classificationReason: Official site identifies 100% free BSD software; backup, encryption, compression and restore workflow in open program, paid offerings are support/storage services. Supports local repositories and SSH repository servers. Recommend stable 1.4, not master/2.0 testing.
serviceLimitations: Third-party repository hosting/support costs separate from software; Windows WSL/Cygwin support experimental, not a native Windows managed-backup agent.

health.rsx: Central rsx analyze: overall 7/10; advisory health signal, not a security certification.

oss.name: Kopia
oss.classificationReason: Open CLI exposes all features, with official desktop GUI and optional repository server; no paid software edition identified. Tier A covers this backup tool, not managed storage or whole-machine imaging.
serviceLimitations: User provisions and pays storage separately; no bundled unlimited backup cloud.
Repository server permissions cover snapshot/policy manifests; known content IDs can expose shared repository content.

health.rsx: Central rsx analyze: overall 6.9/10; advisory health signal, not a security certification.

alternatives.migrationNotes: File-backup option for operators comfortable configuring a CLI, retention/scheduling and storage. New repository and first backup required; no bundled unlimited cloud or equivalent managed endpoint console established. Backblaze B2 storage, if selected, is separate from Business Backup.

Desktop GUI file snapshots on Windows/macOS/Linux with user-selected storage. Recreate policies and seed a new backup; cloud capacity and recovery operations belong to the user. B2 integration uses a separate object-storage service, not the Business Backup subscription.

Limited to self-operated Unix-like file/archive backups and restores, using local or SSH repositories. Does not establish replacement for Acronis imaging, application-aware workloads, endpoint security or cloud failover. Windows support experimental; keep proprietary archives recoverable separately.

Replaces selected file/directory snapshot and restore workflows after creating new backups. Kopia expressly does not image the machine; Acronis system imaging, endpoint protection and cloud failover remain separate requirements. No proprietary-archive import established.

uncertainties: Acronis was underspecified; this record explicitly targets business Cyber Protect, not consumer True Image or all Acronis products. Current entry amount unavailable from rendered official purchasing page.

hostedOffer for BorgBackup means official-listed third-party repository hosting, not a first-party SaaS edition; for restic and Kopia no project-operated managed backup service identified. Cloud object storage integrations alone are not hosted software editions.

No documented importer for Backblaze Business Backup histories or Acronis proprietary archives was established. Migration edges describe creating new backups; preserve incumbent recovery access while validating restores.
